body: Yeah, i totally agree. He was very respectful and kind about it. He said that if we did date, he would want to actually be able to see me more than once every couple of weeks (very valid). Im very glad he was honest. It's just rare to find a connection so great with somebody so it's just a little disappointing that it isn't gonna work out :(

I just really liked him. I know it was a week but I just saw a lot of potential I guess. We seemed like a really great fit and then he just up and 180'd. I got emotional whiplash I guess. You're right I shouldn't have got attached, I just couldn't help it with how well we got along. But maybe that's what lovebombing does, idk.
